description: WebDAV .NET is a WebDAV client library for .NET, built on HttpClient with an asynchronous API. It supports RFC 4918 and the WebDAV extensions in common use: list folders and subfolders, upload and download files with progress and cancellation, resume downloads, copy, move, rename and delete files and folders, read and update properties, lock files and folders, prevent lost updates with ETags, read permissions and access control lists (RFC 3744), quota (RFC 4331), collection synchronization (RFC 6578), search (RFC 5323), extended MKCOL (RFC 5689), bindings (RFC 5842), ordered collections (RFC 3648), versioning (RFC 3253) and more. Tested with Apache mod_dav, SabreDAV (the WebDAV server of Nextcloud and ownCloud) and Go x/net/webdav; works with any RFC 4918 server. The library is written in 100% managed code and has no dependencies besides .NET.
releaseNotes: Version 2.0 is a new library with a new API. WebdavClient replaces Resource and WebdavSession; all request methods are asynchronous and built on HttpClient; errors throw WebdavException with the HTTP status and the server's DAV:error condition. New: progress and cancellation for transfers, resumable downloads, conditional requests (ETags), automatic lock token submission, recursive listing on servers that refuse Depth infinity, access control (RFC 3744), quota (RFC 4331), current user principal (RFC 5397), collection synchronization (RFC 6578), SEARCH (RFC 5323), extended MKCOL (RFC 5689), bindings (RFC 5842), ordered collections (RFC 3648), versioning (RFC 3253), redirect references (RFC 4437), mount documents (RFC 4709), POST to add members (RFC 5995) and Prefer (RFC 8144). See the README for upgrading from 1.x.
summary: WebDAV client library for .NET: async, HttpClient-based, RFC 4918 with locking, properties, ACL, quota, sync and search.
title: WebDAV .NET
